allies.title: Most often beside {nickname}
allies.description: The players who have been on {nickname}’s team in at least two of the battles we hold, most often first. From ten battles together, the wins {nickname} took beside them against what {nickname} usually wins in the same modes: a clan plays its Skirmishes together, so a raw win rate would blame clanmates for the mode. Over a few dozen battles, a couple of wins either way is still chance.
allies.caption: battles, {delta} wins vs usual

opponents.title: Most often against {nickname}
opponents.description: The players who have been on the other team in at least two of the battles we hold, most often first. From ten battles, the wins {nickname} took against them compared with what {nickname} usually wins in the same modes. Over a few dozen battles, a couple of wins either way is still chance.
opponents.caption: battles, {delta} wins vs usual
